skill.name: Epic Generation
skill.purpose: Generate high-level business Epics from functional current-state evidence and target transformation intent.

epic_names.when_empty: LLM derives Epic titles from evidence using business capability/outcome naming.
epic_names.when_provided: Use user Epic names verbatim as epic title; do not rename or rephrase; one Epic per name; id, folder, and file are epic-<verbatim title> (e.g. epic-System Data Management). Never EPIC-001.

codebase.purpose: Validate actual legacy/current capability where necessary.

csa_output.purpose: Primary source for functional current-state understanding.

architecture_blueprint.purpose: Understand target capability direction and architectural boundaries without introducing implementation detail.

migration_strategy.purpose: Understand transformation scope and sequencing constraints.

rules: Consolidate related functionality into a meaningful business capability.
Keep Epic as one business capability. Feature count underneath is NOT fixed at 1: use feature_selection (epic-N-feature-M) or LLM decision when that input is empty.
Use business terminology from the source material.

must: represent a business capability and outcome

rules: JSON agents write schema-complete JSON under src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/ only. Markdown Renderer (Claude Sonnet 4.5) writes matching .md twins under src/artifacts/projections/backlog/. Do not dual-write Markdown from JSON agents.
JSON path root: src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/. Markdown path root: src/artifacts/projections/backlog/.
All skill schema required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; otherwise status=incomplete and retry.
Never write under src/canonical/ or use flat Feature/FAC/AAC siblings of Epic.

schema_completeness_gate.rule: STRICT schema compliance — All output.required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; never rename/drop/stub required fields

feature_selection.when_empty: LLM decides how many Features each Epic needs from evidence.
feature_selection.when_provided: Tokens epic-N-feature-M. N=1-based Epic order; M=exact Feature count.

story_layer_selection.when_provided: Tokens epic-N-feature-M-story-<layers>. Only those layers get Stories.

skill.human_readable_refs: Never refer to Epic/Feature/FAC/AAC/Story/SAC by ID alone; always include the human title/name with the id.
skill.markdown_no_json_dump: Never paste full JSON into Markdown. JSON already exists in canonical files.
